source: DESIGN.md section 11.3 (S1-S17), plus the base URL requirement (BU*)

scenarios.title: The api_key argument travels as Authorization: Bearer
RASK_API_KEY supplies the key when no argument does
The argument wins over RASK_API_KEY
No key at all: a clear error naming RASK_API_KEY, before any request
The key does not show in repr, toString or the client's logs
The default base URL is https://api.rask.ai/v3
scenarios.note: Read it from the client's configuration. Never send a request here: the default points at production.

scenarios.title: base_url argument with a path prefix: every request stays under the prefix
scenarios.note: URL resolution of a path starting with "/" (new URL, urljoin, URI.resolve, Guzzle base_uri) silently drops the prefix.

scenarios.title: A base_url ending in "/" produces the same paths, with no double slash
RASK_BASE_URL supplies the base URL when no argument does
RASK_BASE_URL ending in "/" works the same
The base_url argument wins over RASK_BASE_URL
A GET redirected to another host does not carry the key there
scenarios.note: Following without Authorization and refusing to follow both pass. Same-hostname, other-port leaks count too: the other listener has another host name AND port.

scenarios.title: A POST redirected to another host does not carry the key there
The presigned PUT goes to the storage host without Authorization; the API calls keep it
Location and links.* say /v3/...: following them must stay under a custom prefix
scenarios.note: The contract's links are path-absolute with /v3 (DESIGN 4.2). Against a custom prefix an SDK that resolves them on the origin leaves the API. Take the id, or re-root the link under base_url.

scenarios.title: 429 is retried, no sooner than Retry-After
502, 503 and 504 are retried with backoff, even when the body is HTML
A connection dropped before the headers or in mid-body is retried
A request that times out is retried
A POST is retried because it carries a key; the key and the body do not change
A DELETE is retried because a repeat returns 204, and carries no key
500 is not retried
A 409 state conflict is not retried
409 idempotency_key_in_use is retried after Retry-After with the same key
idempotency_key_in_use is retried at most 3 times, then raised
A service that stays down: retrying stops within 120 s
scenarios.note: Takes about two minutes. Run it nightly, or with the SDK's clock compressed if it has one.

scenarios.title: POST, PATCH and PUT each send a UUIDv4 Idempotency-Key the caller did not ask for
Two logical calls send two different keys
POST, PATCH and PUT keep their key across retries
A key the caller passes is sent verbatim, also on retries
The key that was sent is readable on a result and on an error
deleteSegment carries a key, stable across retries; other DELETEs and GETs carry none
Operations that require a key get one without the caller's help
An auto-paging iterator walks 3 pages over next_cursor
Page-level access: one page, its next_cursor and has_more, and the next page only on request
A short or empty page with has_more does not end the iteration
scenarios.note: DESIGN 4.5: lists that filter after the query may return fewer than limit items with has_more.

scenarios.title: Every page repeats the same filters; the harness answers 400 invalid_cursor otherwise
A single page with next_cursor null needs one request
jobs.wait loops wait_seconds=20, honours Retry-After, and returns the succeeded job
A failed job raises JobFailedError carrying the job's problem
A canceled job raises JobCanceledError
A job that outlives the timeout raises WaitTimeoutError and is left running
jobs.wait defaults to 14400 s
A 503 or a dropped connection during the wait does not end the wait
An SDK that sends If-None-Match gets 304 and keeps waiting
scenarios.note: 304 has no body. An SDK that does not send If-None-Match never sees it and passes by polling.

scenarios.title: upload_file: createUpload, one PUT with the signed headers, completeUpload
upload_file also takes a stream, sent with the signed Content-Length
A failed PUT is retried with the whole file
After 3 whole-file retries the PUT is given up and the upload is not completed
Storage says the URL expired: re-sign through getUpload and PUT to the new URL
A URL already past expires_at: re-sign before or after trying it
webhooks.unwrap: Later, with webhooks (D6)
scenarios.note: Not part of GA: the contract has no webhook operations yet.

scenarios.title: 402 raises InsufficientBalanceError with every Problem member and the balance members
400 is raised, not retried
401 is raised, not retried
403 is raised, not retried
404 is raised, not retried
409 cost_changed is raised with its members, not retried
410 is raised, not retried
413 is raised, not retried
415 is raised, not retried
422 is raised with its errors[], not retried

errors.detail: expected_cost_minutes is required when auto_dub is true.

scenarios.title: 429 whose Retry-After outlasts the 120 s budget is raised, with retry_after
scenarios.note: An interpretation of S3: a wait that cannot be honoured within the budget ends the retries at once. Say so if your SDK should differ.

scenarios.title: 503 whose Retry-After outlasts the 120 s budget is raised
A problem code the SDK has never seen raises the base error with the code intact
An error with an HTML body raises the typed error by status, without a parse failure
A resource exposes etag, matching the ETag header
Single-segment mutations, the speaker voice and translation settings send if_match verbatim, quotes included
updateSegment without if_match does not compile, or raises before sending
updateTranslationSettings without if_match sends none
mergeSegments carries ETags in its body and createSegment none; neither sends If-Match
412 is never retried automatically, and exposes current_etag
428 is never retried automatically
Status, Location, X-Request-Id and Idempotent-Replayed are readable without a second call
A read exposes ETag and X-Request-Id without a second call
An error exposes its X-Request-Id too
Unknown enum values in a job are preserved, not fatal
Unknown union variants in a job are preserved, not fatal
Unknown fields in a job are preserved, not fatal
jobs.wait treats a status it does not know as still running
Every operation with a JSON response survives unknown enum values
scenarios.note: Call every operation that GET /__control/operations marks has_json_response, with its sample. Decoding is what is under test.

scenarios.title: Every operation with a JSON response survives unknown union variants
Every operation with a JSON response survives unknown fields
Every clearable PATCH field clears with "": the SDK sends the empty string, never null, and does not drop it
A field the caller did not set is omitted: requests never send null
The default per-request timeout is 60 s
A long-poll held for 45 s (25 s budget + 20 s wait) does not time out on the defaults
One warning per operation on the first Deprecation header
No Deprecation header, no warning
An operation with deprecated: true gets the language's deprecation marker
scenarios.note: The contract has no deprecated operation yet, so check it by generating from a copy with one marked.

scenarios.title: User-Agent: rask-sdk-<lang>/<version> <runtime>/<version>
RASK_LOG=debug logs traffic with Authorization and presigned signatures redacted
Without RASK_LOG the SDK logs no traffic
TypeScript refuses to run in a browser unless dangerouslyAllowBrowser: true

expect_sdk.text: With window and document defined, new Rask(...) throws an error naming dangerouslyAllowBrowser; with dangerouslyAllowBrowser: true it constructs.
